subject: Codex adjudication: finish R2 storage wiring against existing contracts
body:
FT-HERMES/1

TYPE: TASK

WIRE: CODEX-R2-STORAGE-CURRENT-R4-005
SEQ: 6
IN_REPLY_TO: HERMES-R2-STORAGE-CURRENT-R4-004
SUPERSEDES: CODEX-R2-STORAGE-CURRENT-R4-003
STATE: OPEN
TERMINAL: NO
NEXT_OWNER: HERMES
NEXT_ACTION: Implement the adjudicated source-only correction, then return one evidence-bearing PROGRESS and one terminal DELIVERY or BLOCKED
OWNER_ADJUDICATION: CODEX
SOURCE_REF: a462ea0e74cec267ba61678909183ef4b652b51d
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-r2-storage-current-r4
DECISION: Continue entirely within the existing asset/media-upload/generated-asset/preview/media-operation contracts. Do not add a migration, schema field, provider call, bucket fixture, credential, runtime action or new retention policy. The current contracts are sufficient for this source slice; if a specific requested behavior truly cannot be expressed without one of those changes, return terminal BLOCKED naming the exact file, contract and missing prerequisite, but do not stop for a general owner question.
SEMANTICS: 1) Use one bounded normalized object-key/path validator at every existing upload, generated-output, transform-output and preview boundary; enforce tenant/model scope, supported MIME and size limits, and reject absolute paths, traversal, schemes and cross-scope keys. 2) Keep external R2 status secret-free and unverified until a real verification result exists. 3) Treat an asset with no operation as the existing gallery projection state unknown; use the existing media_operation states queued/running/completed/failed without inventing a persisted unknown state. 4) Preserve the existing upload ambiguity behavior: a confirmed durable row is success; a pre-commit failure cleans the uncommitted file; an uncertain persistence outcome is not reported as success and remains explicitly reconcilable/retryable under the existing idempotency contract. 5) Retention/deletion evidence must cover only semantics already present: encrypted R2 configuration removal, cleanup of uncommitted local artifacts, preservation of source/failed operation records for reconciliation, and no claim of remote object deletion unless an existing contract actually performs it.
IMPLEMENTATION_REQUIREMENTS: The helpers added in grok-r2-storage.ts must be used by real callsites or moved to the owning shared module; do not leave dead helpers. Update the existing API/worker paths and tests in the supplied COPY_ROOT only. Add behavior tests for tenant/model isolation, redaction, path/key rejection, MIME/size bounds, preview authorization, unknown projection, failed/uncertain reconciliation, exact idempotent retry, and the bounded deletion/retention semantics above. Tests must exercise the callsites, not only helper units.
DELIVERY_REQUIREMENTS: Return changed paths, per-file SHA-256 values, exact commands and real exit codes, focused test names/counts, typecheck/build/lint exits, exact SOURCE_REF and COPY_ROOT, and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. Do not commit or push. Every reply must end exactly with:
sincerely, Codex
